task.text: `Uploader` needs a blob store and an event bus that belong to the same environment.
`BlobStore`, `EventBus` and the **abstract factory** `Infra` are given (read-only). Implement the two families, the client and the selector.

items: `LocalInfra()` and `CloudInfra(String bucket)` implement `Infra`; the comments in `Infra.java` give each product's output. A blank bucket throws `IllegalArgumentException`.
`Uploader(Infra)`: `upload(key, body)` stores the body, then publishes the location on topic `uploaded` and returns the receipt.
`Infras.forEnv(String)`: `dev` is local, `prod` is `CloudInfra("acme-prod")`, anything else throws `IllegalArgumentException`.

task.text: `Uploader` must never name a concrete family.

checks.title: Uploader uses the family it is given
Uploader holds a private final Infra
Uploader never names a concrete family

hints.text: The point is consistency: a blob store and a bus must come from the same environment. The thing that varies is the whole family, so one object should hand out all of its products.

`LocalInfra` and `CloudInfra` each return their own `BlobStore` and `EventBus` (lambdas work, since both are single-method). `Uploader` stores only an `Infra` and calls `blobs()` and `events()`. Only `Infras` chooses a family.
